question: A high speed memory is placed between the Central Processing Unit (CPU) and the primary memory known as _______ memory.
solution: The correct answer is __**cache**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Cache** • Cache me mory is a high-speed memory located between the CPU and primary memory (RAM). • It stores frequently accessed data and instructions, allowing the CPU to access this information more quickly than it could from RAM. • Cache memory significantly improves the overall speed and efficiency of the computing process by reducing the time needed to access data.
